Now I have the complete picture. Let me compile the answer.

h15.

Memo visibility is enforced at these distinct server-side sites:

1. **GetMemo / checkMemoReadAccess** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (line 39–67; also used by `GetMemo` at line 356 and `ListMemoComments` at line 148 of `memo_service_comments.go`)

2. **ListMemos (query-time visibility filter)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (lines 218–227: anonymous callers get `VisibilityList = [Public]`; authenticated non-owners get `Public, Protected`)

3. **CreateMemoComment (parent memo visibility gate)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` (line 33–43: blocks commenting on a PRIVATE memo the caller doesn't own)

4. **ListMemoComments (query-time visibility filter on child memos)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` (lines 157–160: filters returned comments by visibility)

5. **ListMemoRelations (query-time visibility filter)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` (lines 108–111: applies `memoFilter` based on caller identity so related memos respect visibility)

6. **ListMemoAttachments (memo visibility check)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` (lines 213–225: checks memo visibility before returning linked attachments)

7. **GetAttachment / checkAttachmentAccess (attachment visibility via linked memo)** — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go` (lines 419–453: resolves the linked memo and enforces its visibility rules)

8. **ListMemoReactions / CreateReaction (memo visibility check)** — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` (lines 29–40 for listing; lines 82–84 for creating: PRIVATE memos block non-owner reactions)

9. **SSE delivery filtering (canReceive)** — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (lines 134–143: PRIVATE events are delivered only to the creator or admins)

10. **File server attachment access (HTTP file serving)** — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` (lines 674–701: enforces memo visibility when serving attachment files over HTTP, including share-token fallback)

11. **Email notifications (canViewerAccessMemo)** — `server/notification/email.go` (lines 306–320: suppresses email notification content when the receiver cannot see the memo)

12. **User notifications / inbox (canViewerAccessMemo)** — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` (lines 302–316, used at line 370: filters inbox/notification entries by memo visibility)

13. **Mention inbox suppression (canUserAccessMentionContext)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go` (lines 56–71: prevents mention notifications when the target user cannot see the PRIVATE memo or its parent)
